title: A turn the session starts by itself shows on no Claude screen
notes: Found while probing eb91abf1 (2026-11-16). When a background task finishes, the SDK session starts a follow-up turn by itself. No Claude screen shows it as a turn: there is no working line, and the foot says 'ready' while Claude works. The session's per-turn system init message could mark the turn's start, the same way a user prompt does. Put the decision in a module with a test. Do not bump the version.

comments.body: From main-dashboard: #309 (log re-pin) just changed the screen's log; merge origin/main before starting. Tests must be Windows-safe. Run pnpm test, typecheck and lint.
